featured_reviews.name: Monsoon Paul
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had ordered for the first time through Ownly app one Classic Cold Coffee and one Oatmeal Raisin Cookie.

Starting with pros then followed by cons :

Packaging - it was good and secured, the coffee was sealed properly no spillage, cute handwritten stuff on the front of the packet but, only the cookie got broken.

Oatmeal Raisin Cookie - it was yummy and soft when just delivered as it was heated. But after 10 mins, it got very hard so had to struggle a little.

Cold coffee - sadly it was a little avg and watery and very light in color. Ordered it just after seeing the reviews as it was one of their best seller. So can be improved by making it little strong (without extra charges) and less watery.

featured_reviews.name: Vinayak Tripathi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Don't go at night. On 12th Jan I Enjoyed Coffee and Food all night (multiple rounds), good wifi, amazing staff, no disturbance
But on 13th Jan night, different staff suddenly it was an "Only Takeaway shop". I was impolietly dismissed from the shop.
So even if it says 24 hours open, it is not, maybe it depends on mood of staff. Owner should update listing

Other than that, Coffee machine good one, cup design very likeable and hot tasty food clean shop, a little small coffee shop. Prices reasonable Rs 80ish for coffee starting and Rs170ish for a quality chicken wrap all presented neatly, I would say is pretty nice. Good branding.

featured_reviews.name: sagar jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently visited ab Coffee at Powai,
The franchise are expanding in Mumbai,

Being a coffee lover, I had high expectation,
I ordered following
1. Signature cold Coffee
2. Cappuccino
Coffee was really good liked it,
but was disappointed with the quantity, (regular cup 250 ml and large one 350 ml)
Though there was combo offer , but only coffee was available in outlet, no bakery item was available.
Ambience is good,owners have taken time for designing interior, Even displaying mission and vision statement in outlet.

It's a small outlet,
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Sagar,

Thank you for your feedback and four-star rating. We're glad you enjoyed our signature cold coffee and cappuccino. We apologize for the disappointment in the quantity and availability of bakery items. We'll ensure to improve in these areas. Your appreciation for our ambience and interior design is heartwarming.

Regards, abCoffee Powai

featured_reviews.name: Sailesh Pokhriyal
featured_reviews.review_text: At times when big names serve watered drinks to feed egos rather than deliver quality products, I've discovered abCoffee accidentally, keeping my hopes alive in modern day Cafés. Delicious, well presented and effort that shows that a thought has gone to make the customer experience better. I'm enjoying every sip of their wonderful offerings while they last but hope to never see their inevitable quality drop when they become big and successful. Cheers!

featured_reviews.name: Curiouslyawed
featured_reviews.review_text: Visited for breakfast. The place was kind of busy. Liked their breakfast menu, and also the mango fest menu they had. Ambience is nice and cozy with both inside and outdoor sections, food was fresh and tasty. The croissant however could have been better, was flaky on the outside but flat on the inside. Staff was average and attentive but not warm. The staff didn't smile even once. But they did their job which is serving, ordertaking, clearance, etc. Hospitality and warmth is lacking. Would visit again for convenience and good menu but not an impressionable place.

featured_reviews.name: george joseph
featured_reviews.review_text: A great spot. I really love the location too. Got the waffles and americano. The waffles were great. Got the strawberry Nutella one which tasted soo good. Their strawberry cream was the king of the dish. Good ambience as well. A perfect date night kinda spot. I felt the service is a bit hurried. It felt like they dumped the plate on the table and scooted off. Their menu looks interesting as well. Everything which kinda scares me but I would put my money on it being good.

featured_reviews.name: Mehvish Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Aromas Cafe and had a really nice experience overall. The service stood out right from the beginning.. my server was very polite and welcoming, and she helped me get seated comfortably.

I started with a fresh lime fizzer, which was honestly perfect for the crazy heat.. super refreshing and well-balanced. Then I tried the chicken tenders, and they were surprisingly really good.. crispy, flavorful, and a great choice.

Later, I ordered a pasta from the menu. It was decent, but I did feel like it could’ve had more veggies to make it better.

That said, the overall experience was great.. good vibes, good service, and some really enjoyable dishes. I’d definitely visit again to try more from the menu!

featured_reviews.name: N S
featured_reviews.review_text: The food at Aroma Cafe is excellent. Everything tasted fresh and well-prepared, with great flavors and generous portions. Every bite was enjoyable. The ambience was  relaxing, making it a decent place to enjoy a meal.

name: Blue Tokai Coffee Roasters | Powai
description:
Nestled in the bustling suburb of Powai, Mumbai, is Blue Tokai's cozy and charming cafe, a coffee lover's paradise. The cafe's decor features spacious interiors and large windows that let in natural light, creating a relaxed and inviting atmosphere.

Savour a wide range of specialty coffees, each made from carefully sourced beans roasted in-house, and indulge in fresh bakes and sandwiches from Suchali's Artisan Bakehouse. Whether you're meeting up with friends or need a quiet spot to work, the Powai cafe has ample seating and is pet-friendly.

Located near major business centres and educational institutions, Blue Tokai's Powai cafe is a popular spot for locals and tourists alike.

Our menu is inclusive and allergy-friendly, with a wide range of plant-based milk options to cater to all dietary needs. We take pride in our vibrant matcha menu, crafted with premium ingredients.

featured_reviews.name: Farheen Darwesh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I really wanted to like this place. The café has a lovely vibe — tastefully done décor, calm and quiet, and even the other guests are respectful about noise. The service is also genuinely good, especially considering there was just one person handling orders and serving.

Unfortunately, the food completely ruined the experience.

I ordered a penne pesto pasta, a Caesar salad, and an orange juice.

The orange juice was the only win: freshly pressed, no added sugar or ice — exactly how juice should be. I appreciate that they don’t use boxed juice or sweeteners.

The penne pesto pasta, however, was genuinely bad. The pasta was so overcooked that it had turned mushy and was breaking apart on the plate — impossible to eat with a fork, only a spoon. The vegetables were completely overcooked too, almost paste-like, as if made for a toddler. Worst of all, the “pesto” was not pesto at all. It was loaded with mayo or a heavy cream-mayo mixture, making it extremely unhealthy and misleading. If it’s a creamy sauce, that should be clearly mentioned. Calling this pesto is simply incorrect and disappointing.

The Caesar salad was even worse. It was drowning in what tasted like sweetened mayo — so sugary it could qualify as a dessert. There was nothing Caesar about it: no parmesan, no Worcestershire flavour, no balance. Just vegetables submerged in a thick, overly sweet dressing.

I really hope the café revisits its recipes or at the very least clearly mentions ingredients and preparation styles. What’s listed on the menu and what’s served on the plate are worlds apart, making it impossible for customers to make informed choices.

Great space and service, but the food needs serious rethinking.

The buffet boasted an impressively expansive spread, encompassing Southeast Asian, Indian, and continental cuisines, reflecting commendable variety and ambition. However, the execution fell short of expectation, with the offerings lacking any discernible “wow” factor.

A particularly notable drawback was the quality of the chicken across several dishes, which appeared less than fresh and was consistently tough, detracting significantly from the dining experience. Even relatively straightforward preparations, such as the pasta, required multiple iterations before reaching an acceptable standard—an avoidable lapse in a setting of this calibre.

Service, too, proved to be disappointingly pedestrian, falling well below the benchmark set by establishments such as JW Marriott Mumbai and Taj Mahal Palace.

In sum, while the breadth of the spread is undeniably impressive, the inconsistency in execution and lacklustre service rendered the experience far from memorable.

Blue Tokai Coffee Roasters – A Coffee Lover’s Paradise

As someone who has tried almost every major coffee chain in Mumbai — from Starbucks to Tim Hortons, Costa Coffee, and AB Coffee etc. — I can confidently say that Blue Tokai serves the best coffee I’ve had so far. Of course, coffee is a personal experience and taste varies for each individual, but for me, their brews hit the perfect balance of flavor, aroma, and strength.

Their Cappuccino and Americano are my absolute favorites — smooth, well-balanced, and rich. They also have an extensive coffee menu with different brewing styles, so whether you like a strong espresso, a light pour-over, or a creamy latte, you’ll find something to suit your taste. Apart from coffee, they offer a good selection of bakes, snacks, and light meals, which pair perfectly with your drink.

If you’re a regular visitor, I highly recommend downloading and paying via their Blue Tokai app — you earn points on every purchase which can be redeemed later, making it rewarding for frequent coffee drinkers.

The ambience is calm and inviting, with plenty of natural light streaming in through the large windows, simple yet elegant decor, and cozy seating perfect for catching up with friends, working, or just enjoying your coffee in peace.

featured_reviews.name: SGT Reviews
featured_reviews.review_text:
Third Wave Coffee, Thakur Complex – Late Nights Done Right

Some places are built for brunch.
This one? Built for 11:30 PM conversations that accidentally stretch into the night.

We dropped by Third Wave Coffee at Thakur Complex close to midnight, and the biggest win right away it’s 24/7. In a city where most cafés shut just when you start craving coffee, this already puts it ahead of the curve.

📍 Location & Accessibility

Right off the main road in Thakur Complex, so no hunting through lanes or Google Maps confusion.

Easy to reach

Easy to spot

And more importantly easy to rely on, even late at night

☕ Coffee & Drinks – Mostly Hits, One Miss

We tried:

Vietnamese Matcha

French Vanilla Latte

Hot Chocolate

Sea Salt Mocha

Verdict?

Vietnamese Matcha – unique, well-balanced, not overly sweet

Hot Chocolate – comforting, smooth, exactly what you expect

Sea Salt Mocha – standout; that sweet-salty balance hits just right

Only slight miss:

French Vanilla Latte – lacked sweetness, felt a bit underwhelming compared to the rest
🥪 Food – Solid Support Cast

Paneer Tikka Sandwich – flavourful, satisfying

Mexican Masala Sandwich – nicely spiced, works well with coffee

Nothing experimental but well executed and dependable, which is exactly what you want in a café setting.

🪑 Ambience & Vibe

Clean, warm lighting, and that familiar café energy where:

Some people are working

Some are catching up

Some are just unwinding after a long day

Late at night, it feels even better less noise, more vibe.
📊 SGT Decision Scorecard

Parameter	Score	Insight

Accessibility	9/10	Prime location, easy entry
Experience Quality	8/10	Strong drinks, good food
Consistency	8/10	Mostly on point
Value for Money	8/10	Worth it for the overall experience

🎯 Reality Verdict

✅ Go for: Late-night coffee runs, casual meetups, reliable café experience

⚠️ Be aware: Some drinks may need slight tweaking (like sweetness levels)

💎 Best use case: When the city is shutting down, but you’re not

🧾 Final Take

Third Wave Coffee here isn’t trying to be fancy it’s trying to be reliable, accessible, and consistently good.

And honestly? It succeeds.

Because sometimes, the best café isn’t the one with the best coffee
it’s the one that’s open when you need it, and delivers when you show up.

featured_reviews.review_text:
A Cozy Café Experience with Great Variety in Ghatkopar!

Recently visited ERA77, and it turned out to be a lovely spot for café-style food with a mix of comfort and global flavours.

We kicked things off with the Mini Vada Pav — bite-sized, nostalgic, and full of flavour. A fun desi touch that instantly sets the mood. The Hummus Avocado Toast was fresh and wholesome, perfectly balanced and ideal for anyone who enjoys light, healthy café food.

The Bagel Sandwich was filling and well put together, with great texture and flavours in every bite. Moving to Asian options, the Chilly Garlic Ramen packed a nice punch — spicy, aromatic, and comforting. The Buddha Delight Noodles were equally satisfying, loaded with veggies and clean flavours.

Drinks were a highlight too. The Coffee Mocha was rich and indulgent, while the Classic Cappuccino was smooth and well brewed. To end on a refreshing note, the Berry Blast Boba Tea was fruity, fun, and a perfect pick-me-up.

Overall, ERA77 offers a relaxed café vibe with a thoughtfully curated menu that caters to different tastes — from desi snacks to global bowls and great beverages. Definitely a recommended spot in Ghatkopar for café hopping and casual catch-ups
